rules.title: An extension used anywhere in the file is listed in extensionsUsed

spec.quote: All extensions that are used in a glTF document shall be listed in the top-level extensionsUsed array object

rules.title: An MPEG_* extension name is one this document defines
rules.note: A warning: the text lists the extensions this document defines and does not forbid other MPEG_ names (other documents or editions may define more). Names the text uses in place of an older name are given as a hint.

rules.title: An extension appears only on the object its clause names

spec.quote: When present, the MPEG_buffer_circular extension shall be included as extension of a buffer object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.

mpeg.quote: When present, the MPEG_node_interactivity extension shall be included as extension to a node object.

rules.note: One sentence per extension: the first quotation is the buffer one, the others follow in spec_more; the node interactivity one is in the MPEG README.

spec_more.quote: When present, the MPEG_media extension shall be included as a top-level extension.
When present, the MPEG_scene_dynamic extension shall be included as extension of a scene object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.
When present, the MPEG_mesh_linking extension shall be included as extension of a mesh object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.
When present, the MPEG_audio_spatial extension shall be included as extension of a camera object, or a scene object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.
When present, the MPEG_viewport_recommended extension shall be included as extension of a scene object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.
When present, the MPEG_animation_timing extension shall be included as extension of a scene object defined in ISO/IEC 12113.
When present, the MPEG_scene_interactivity extension shall be included as extension to the scene object.

rules.title: An extension in extensionsRequired is also in extensionsUsed

spec.quote: extensions that are required to correctly load/render the scene shall also be listed in the extensionsRequired array.

rules.title: autoplayGroup is present only when autoplay is true

spec.quote: autoplayGroup is only allowed if autoplay is set to True.

mpeg.quote: autoplayGroup is only allowed if autoplay is set to true.

rules.title: autoplayGroup is an integer
rules.note: Table of 5.2.1.2 gives the type integer; no sentence.

rules.title: startTime is not present when autoplay is true

spec.quote: When present and set to True, startTime shall not be present or shall be ignored by the client.

rules.note: A warning, not an error, because the text lets the client ignore it. The MPEG README (FDIS) says instead that either startTime or autoplay shall be present; the 2024 text has no such sentence, so it is not a rule.

rules.title: endTimeOffset is after startTimeOffset
rules.note: No clause governs this; an empty range is reported as a warning.

rules.title: A buffer with MPEG_buffer_circular has no uri

spec.quote: the buffer element property uri shall not be present

rules.title: media is an entry of MPEG_media

spec.quote: Index of the media entry in the MPEG_media extension, which is used as the source for the input data to the buffer.

rules.title: A listed track exists in every alternative of the media

spec.quote: then the selected track shall be present in all alternatives.

mpeg.quote: then the selected track shall be present in all alternatives.

rules.title: byteLength holds count frames

spec.quote: the buffer element property byteLength shall indicate the maximum possible size of the buffer

rules.note: A warning: the frame size is taken as the extent of the bufferViews of the buffer, which the text does not define; timed data may carry a header or a size the static views do not show.

rules.title: Without a header bufferView the immutable flag is present and true

spec.quote: In that case, the immutable flag shall be present and shall be set to True.

mpeg.quote: In that case, the immutable flag shall be present and shall be set to true.

rules.title: The header bufferView exists

spec.quote: The latter, when present, shall point to the timed accessor information header.

rules.title: The header bufferView is in the same buffer as the accessor's bufferView

spec.quote: The buffer properties in the bufferView element shall point to the same buffer as the bufferView in the containing accessor object.

mpeg.quote: The buffer properties in the `bufferView` element shall point to the same buffer as the `bufferView` in the containing accessor object.

rules.title: A timed accessor points to a buffer with MPEG_buffer_circular

spec.quote: Accessors that include the "MPEG_accessor_timed" extension shall only point to buffers that include the "MPEG_buffer_circular" extension.

rules.title: A buffer does not mix accessors with and without a timed accessor information header

spec.quote: A buffer shall not mix data from dynamic and static components

rules.title: The texture's accessor exists
rules.note: Index into the accessors array; no sentence.

rules.title: The accessor has MPEG_accessor_timed

spec.quote: The accessor shall have the MPEG_accessor_timed extension.

rules.title: The format has as many components as the accessor type

spec.quote: Note that the number of components shall match the type indicated by the referenced accessor.

mpeg.quote: The number of components shall match the type indicated by the referenced `accessor`.

rules.title: On a node, source or listener is present

spec.quote: either MPEG_audio_spatial.source or MPEG_audio_spatial.listener properties of the extension shall be present.

rules.note: The sentence says source or listener; Table 13 names the property sources. Both spellings are accepted.

rules.title: At file level the reverb property is present

spec.quote: MPEG_audio_spatial.reverb property shall be present.

rules.note: The sentence says the reverb property; Table 13 and the schema call it reverbs. Both are accepted, an empty reverbs array is not.

rules.title: reverbFeedGain has as many elements as reverbFeed

spec.quote: The array shall have the same number of elements as the reverbFeed array field.

mpeg.quote: The array shall have the same  number of elements as the reverbFeed array field.

rules.title: clusterProperties is defined when isCluster is true

spec.quote: This object shall be defined, when the isCluster attribute is set to True.

rules.title: referenceDistance is absent when the source type is HOA

spec.quote: When type equals 'HOA', the element shall not be present.

rules.note: The sentence says 'the element'; in Table 14 it follows the referenceDistance row, so referenceDistance is the element.

rules.title: MPEG_anchor is not at scene and node level together

spec.quote: The MPEG_anchor extension shall not be present at scene and node level at the same time in a glTF file conforming to this document.

mpeg.quote: The MPEG_anchor extension shall not be present at scene and node level at the same time in a glTF file conforming to this document.

rules.title: Trackables and anchors are defined at glTF file level

spec.quote: The definition of Trackable and Anchor objects shall be provided within an MPEG_anchor extension at the glTF file level.

mpeg.quote: The definition of Trackable and Anchor objects shall be provided within an MPEG_anchor extension at the glTF file level.

rules.title: An anchor reference is an item of the anchors array
rules.note: Index into the anchors array; no sentence.

rules.title: An anchor's trackable is an item of the trackables array
rules.note: Index into the trackables array; no sentence.

rules.title: A trackable has the properties its type requires
rules.note: Table 29 marks path, geometricConstraint, markerNode, coordinates and trackableId mandatory (M) for their types; no sentence. A scene that spells coordinates as coordinate is REPO-CONFLICT information.

rules.title: markerNode is a node

spec.quote: Index to the node in the nodes array in which the marker geometry and texture are described.

mpeg.quote: Index to the node in the nodes array in which the marker geometry and texture are described.

rules.title: The longitude lies in -180 to 180 degrees

spec.quote: The value is in range of −180.0 to 180.0, inclusive.

rules.title: The latitude lies in -90 to 90 degrees

spec.quote: The value is in range of −90.0 to 90.0, inclusive.

rules.title: A behavior's triggers and actions are items of their arrays
rules.note: Index into the triggers and actions arrays; no sentence.

rules.title: The nodes a trigger or action lists exist
rules.note: Index into the nodes array; no sentence.

rules.title: userInputDescription is an OpenXR path name string

spec.quote: The format shall follow the OpenXR input path description as defined in [OpenXR] section 6.

rules.note: Checked against the rules for path name strings in OpenXR 1.0, clause 6.2 (characters, leading slash, no trailing slash, no adjacent slashes, no period-only segment). The maximum length, XR_MAX_PATH_LENGTH, is not checked: its value is not in the specification.

ref.quote: Path name strings must be constructed entirely from characters on the following list.

rules.title: The translation accessor is FLOAT VEC3

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be FLOAT and the type shall be VEC3, (x, y, z).

rules.title: The rotation accessor is FLOAT VEC4

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be FLOAT and the type shall be VEC4, as a unit quaternion, (x, y, z, w).

rules.title: The parameters accessor is FLOAT VEC4

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be FLOAT and the type shall be VEC4.

rules.title: The animation timing accessor is BYTE SCALAR

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be BYTE and the type shall be SCALAR.

rules.title: The correspondence accessor is SCALAR

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be as indicated in subclause 7.4 and the type shall be SCALAR.

rules.note: The componentType of the correspondence accessor (subclause 7.4) is not checked.

rules.title: The pose accessor is FLOAT MAT4

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be FLOAT and the type shall be MAT4.

rules.title: The weights accessor is FLOAT SCALAR

spec.quote: The componentType of the referenced accessor shall be FLOAT and the type shall be SCALAR.

rules.title: The shadow mesh is an item of the meshes array

spec.quote: Provides a reference to the shadow mesh, by specifying the mesh index in meshes array

rules.title: A buffer file exists and is as long as byteLength
rules.note: glTF 2.0 3.6.1.1, not opened in this work: unverified. The Khronos glTF Validator covers it.

rules.title: An accessor fits its bufferView
rules.note: glTF 2.0 3.6.2.4, not opened in this work: unverified. The Khronos glTF Validator covers it.

rules.title: The extension object satisfies its JSON schema from the MPEG repository
rules.note: Structure only: required properties, types and ranges. Where the repository governs the extension, what a schema requires is an error. Where the PDF governs and a schema differs from it, the finding is SCHEMA-TEXT.

rules.title: No usable JSON schema exists for the extension
rules.note: For example MPEG_lights_texture_based, whose schema file is not valid JSON in the repository.

rules.title: The repository contradicts itself (a README against a schema file); neither is chosen
rules.note: the repository governs an extension changed after the April 2024 PDF; where the repository contradicts itself neither side is chosen. Known case: MPEG_anchor coordinates (README) against coordinate (schema).

rules.title: A schema file differs from the PDF where the PDF governs
rules.note: the PDF governs an extension whose repository files are older than it. Known case: MPEG_viewport_recommended (schema requires viewports, Table 19 defines one viewport).
